dataset.name: AI Pulse Golden Dataset
dataset.description: Golden evaluation set for AI Pulse's ability to identify, classify, prioritize, and summarize AI product updates.

test_cases.description: Major model release with clear implications for creator workflows.

source.title: Example AI Model Released
source.evidence: The company announced a new foundation model with improved video generation, longer context, and faster generation for supported workflows.

key_facts: The announcement occurred within the requested time window
must_not_claim: Universal availability if the source does not state it
Capabilities not described in the announcement

test_cases.description: Product feature release that improves an existing creator workflow without introducing a new model.

source.title: New Image Editing Workflow
source.evidence: The company added batch background removal and expanded export controls to its existing image editor.

key_facts: An existing product gained new functionality
The new functionality affects image editing workflow
The announcement occurred within the requested time window
must_not_claim: Capabilities beyond batch background removal and expanded export controls

test_cases.description: Funding announcement for an AI company with potentially meaningful market implications but limited immediate workflow impact.

source.title: AI Company Announces New Funding Round
source.evidence: The company announced a new funding round intended to expand its AI platform and accelerate product development.

key_facts: The company announced a funding round
The company plans to use the funding to expand its AI platform
must_not_claim: Immediate benefits to creators unless supported by the source

test_cases.description: Rapidly gaining AI tool with strong creator interest but limited formal product-announcement material.

source.title: New AI Video Tool Gains Rapid Attention
source.evidence: The new AI video tool is gaining substantial attention among creators and is being widely shared for its automated short-form video workflow.

key_facts: The tool is receiving rapid attention
The tool is positioned around a video creation workflow
expected.source_integrity_requirement: Clearly distinguish secondary coverage from an official product announcement.
must_not_claim: Official launch details not present in the source

test_cases.description: Recent AI announcement that should be excluded because it has little meaningful impact on creators.

source.title: Enterprise Infrastructure Update
source.evidence: The company announced an internal infrastructure optimization designed to improve enterprise deployment administration.

expected.exclusion_reason: The announcement does not materially affect creator workflows, capabilities, or tools.
must_not_claim: The update is creator-relevant simply because it involves AI

test_cases.description: An otherwise relevant announcement that falls outside the requested recency window.

source.title: New Design Feature Announced
source.evidence: The company announced an AI-assisted layout feature for its design application.

expected.exclusion_reason: The update is relevant but falls outside the requested 48-hour window.
expected.recency_rule: Do not include solely because the update remains relevant.

test_cases.description: The same underlying announcement appears through multiple sources.

source.title: Company X Launches Writing Feature
source.evidence: Company X launched the same AI writing feature announced in the official source earlier that day.

deduplication.expected_behavior: Represent the underlying update once and prefer the official source for attribution.

must_not_claim: Additional capabilities that appear only in duplicated coverage

test_cases.description: Announcement combines a product capability release with a broader launch that could be classified multiple ways.

source.title: Creative AI Platform Launch
source.evidence: The company launched a new creative AI platform that includes a newly released image-generation model and several workflow features.

expected.category_rationale: The primary announcement centers on a newly released model; the workflow features are supporting capabilities.
must_not_claim: That the update is exclusively a feature release
Capabilities not described in the source

test_cases.description: Relevant update is reported by secondary sources, but no official announcement can be verified.

source.title: Reports Suggest AI Writing Upgrade Is Coming
source.evidence: Multiple sources report that the company may soon introduce a new AI writing capability, but no official announcement is available.

expected.source_integrity_requirement: Clearly label the item as reported or unconfirmed.

test_cases.description: Update is moderately important to the broader AI market but highly relevant to a specific creator niche.

source.title: New AI Design Workflow Integration
source.evidence: The company added an AI-assisted design workflow that automatically generates layout variations from an existing creative brief.

expected.relevance_rationale: The capability directly affects the target Design creator's workflow even if the announcement has limited broader market attention.
must_not_claim: High general-market popularity is required for high creator relevance
Support for workflows not described in the source
